title: メディア情報論Ⅱ
subtitle: Media Informatics II
keywords: Cognitive information processing 2.Sensibility and emotional information processing 3.Vision psychology 4.Auditory psychology 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn human visual and auditory processing within the context of physiology and psychology. (2) Learn cognitive, sensibility, and emotional information processing for media contents. (3) Learn the method for creating affecting contents. (4) Discuss content application for regional cooperation.
advice: In this course. based on the knowledge imparted during “Media Informatics I”, the cognitive, sensibility, and emotional information processing of media contents (pictures, movies, music, etc.) will be examined. As a part of the course, students will learn and practice to simulate the human processing via computer programming. Accordingly, students should review the contents of “Media Informatics I”, “Media Informatics II”, and ther computer programming courses.
requiredKnowledge: An understanding of the contents of “Media Informatics I” and “Media Informatics II” is required. Basic computer programming skills are required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand human cognitive processing for visual and auditory stimuli.
Be able to understand human sensibility and emotional processing for visual and auditory stimuli.
Be able to understand the method of simulating the above-mentioned processing via computer programming.
Be able to understand the method of engineering design of media contents

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Be able to explain human cognitive processing for visual and auditory stimuli (2) Be able to explain human sensibility and emotional processing for visual and auditory stimuli. achievementLevels.standard: (1) Be able to explain human visual and auditory perception mechanism. (2) Be able to understand human cognitive processing for visual and auditory stimuli. (3) Be able to understand human sensibility and emotional processing for visual and auditory stimuli. (4) Be able to understand the method used for simulating the abovementioned processing via computer programming. (5) Be able to understand the method of engineering design of media contents.

lessons.content: Course introduction Review of Media Informatics I
Auditory system I ・Structure of the Cochlea ・Place and temporal theories of pitch
Auditory system II ・Role of auditory brain stem ・Processing in auditory cortex
Music information Technologies based on psychoacoustics ・Audio compression ・Music Information Retrieval
lessons.assignments: Lecture review Prepare for the experiment
Lecture review Prepare for the exam (including assignment sheet)

lessons.content: The eye and visual cortex ・Structure of the eye ・Retina ・Signal transfer to the brain ・Processing in visual cortex
Spatial and temporal properties of visual receptive fields ・Receptive field ・Visual temporal properties ・Visual spatial properties
Spatial vision and depth perception ・Adaptation and after-effect ・Perception of size and orientation ・Depth perception
Motion perception ・Retinal motion ・Motion detector ・Apparent motion ・Vection
lessons.assignments: Lecture review Prepare for the experiment
Write a paper about the experiment

lessons.content: Color vision ・Three cones and opposite color mechanism ・Munsell color system and 3 attributes of color ・Color constancy ・Color naming

lessons.assignments: Prepare for the exam (including assignment sheet)
